storeInfo.name: The Plum Tomato
storeInfo.tagline: Fresh ingredients, bold flavors, and warm Connecticut hospitality

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Tomates ciruela frescos marinados en ajo, albahaca y aceite de oliva virgen extra, servidos sobre pan rústico tostado.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh plum tomatoes marinated in garlic, basil, and extra virgin olive oil, served atop toasted artisanal rustic bread.

products.descriptionEs: Calamares empanizados y fritos a la perfección, acompañados de salsa marinara casera y rodajas de limón.
products.descriptionEn: Tender calamari lightly breaded and fried to golden perfection, served with house-made marinara sauce and fresh lemon wedges.

products.descriptionEs: Queso mozzarella fresco de búfala, rodajas de tomate maduro, albahaca fresca y un toque de glaseado de balsámico añejo.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh buffalo mozzarella, ripe sliced tomatoes, fresh basil leaves, and a drizzle of aged balsamic glaze.

products.descriptionEs: Salsa de tomate plum, mozzarella fresca, albahaca fresca y aceite de oliva virgen extra sobre masa madre.
products.descriptionEn: Signature plum tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, torn basil leaves, and extra virgin olive oil on hand-stretched sourdough crust.

products.descriptionEs: Nuestra pizza insignia con salchicha italiana, pepperoni, champiñones, pimientos, cebolla y extra queso mozzarella.
products.descriptionEn: Our signature loaded pizza topped with Italian sausage, crispy pepperoni, mushrooms, bell peppers, onions, and extra mozzarella.

products.descriptionEs: Pasta fettuccine fresca bañada en una cremosa salsa de mantequilla y queso parmesano, coronada con pechuga de pollo a la parrilla.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh fettuccine pasta tossed in a rich, creamy parmesan and butter sauce, topped with tender grilled chicken breast.

products.descriptionEs: Pechuga de pollo empanizada al horno con salsa marinara casera y queso mozzarella derretido, servida con espagueti.
products.descriptionEn: Breaded chicken breast baked with our signature house marinara and melted mozzarella cheese, served with a side of spaghetti.

products.descriptionEs: Capas de pasta ancha, ragú de carne cocinado a fuego lento, ricotta cremosa y mozzarella, horneadas a la perfección.
products.descriptionEn: Layered wide pasta sheets with slow-cooked meat ragù, creamy ricotta blend, and bubbling mozzarella baked to perfection.
Delicate ravioli stuffed with tender lobster meat in a smooth, velvety pink vodka sauce infused with cherry tomatoes.
Refreshing sparkling water mixed with sweet raspberry syrup and a splash of cream over ice.
Freshly brewed premium black tea, served chilled over ice with fresh lemon slices and mint.
Crispy pastry shell filled with sweet, creamy ricotta filling and mini dark chocolate chips.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con opciones vegetarianas y alternativas sin gluten para nuestras pizzas y pastas. Pregunte a su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer vegetarian choices and gluten-free crust or pasta alternatives. Please ask your server for details.

faqs.qEn: Do you accept reservations for large parties?
faqs.aEs: Aceptamos reservaciones por teléfono y tenemos espacio para celebraciones y fiestas privadas. Contáctenos para más información.
faqs.aEn: We accept phone reservations and accommodate private parties and celebrations. Contact us for details.
